name: Summarize a sales call, log it in Salesforce and send the follow-up
description: Your call recorder (Fireflies, Gong, Zoom or any tool that can call a webhook) posts the finished call's transcript or summary. An AI agent extracts key points, objections, commitments and next steps, finds the matching Salesforce opportunity and drafts a CRM note and a follow-up email to the attendees. A person edits and approves both, then the note is logged as a Salesforce task and the email is sent from Gmail.
shortDescription: Turn every recorded sales call into a CRM note and a follow-up email, approved by the rep.
keyFeatures: Works with any recorder that can post the transcript or summary to a webhook
AI Agent with the post-call-follow-up skill and a Salesforce SOQL tool to match the record
Approval form with the CRM note and email editable before anything is written or sent
Next steps without a stated owner or date are marked TBD, never guessed
prerequisites: The `post-call-follow-up` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
Salesforce connection that can read Contact and Opportunity and create Task records
Google Mail (Gmail) connection for the follow-up email
A call recorder or automation that posts JSON with title, attendees (emails) and transcript or summary to the workflow's webhook URL
Server public URL configured, so the webhook and the approval form link can be reached
idealFor: Account executives who want every call logged and followed up within minutes, without writing notes by hand.
steps: Trigger: the call recorder posts the finished call to the webhook.
Draft the follow-up: the AI Agent loads the post-call-follow-up skill, summarizes the call, matches the Salesforce opportunity and drafts the CRM note and the email.
Approve: the run pauses until the rep reviews and edits the note and the email.
Approved: log the note as a completed Salesforce task and send the email from Gmail.
Rejected: log the comment and write nothing.
